reply_text:
I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the records don't support 261, so the figure for the tracker is 185 seats for the 2026 term, rising to 230 on 2027-01-01.

- **Where 261 came from:** only Ilse's Oct 14 message. When I acknowledged it I hadn't checked it against the account records, and I should have. No contract or account page I found gives 261.
- **2026 renewal order form** (signed 2026-03-20, runs 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31): it doesn't state a seat count. It only changes the terms it lists, so the existing count carried over.
- **The existing count is 185.** That comes from Amendment No. 1 (Aug 2025, after Dana corrected 180 to 185 in the channel), and the QFL account page also shows 185 active seats.
- **Amendment No. 3** (signed 2026-09-22) takes the account to 230 seats from 2027-01-01.

In the same reply I asked Ilse where 261 came from, in case there's a document I can't see. I didn't include any pricing or discount terms.
